```{r Data Cleansing (LOCO CV)}
# ==============================================================================
# DATA CLEANSING & FEATURE ENGINEERING (EXPANDED ARBITRAGE UNIVERSE)
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(spatialRF)
library(parallel)
library(lightgbm)
library(stats) 

file_path <- "C:/Users/user/Desktop/UM/OneDrive - Universiti Malaya/SQB7038 Research Project/UM PG Research Project/Dataset/Global AI Job Market & Salary Trends 2025/ai_job_dataset1.csv"
job_data <- read.csv(file_path)

# 3. EXPANDED ECONOMIC LOOKUP TABLE (52 Countries Total)
# All indices uniformly updated to 2025 releases to ensure stable covariance 
econ_lookup <- data.frame(
  company_location = c(
    # Original 28 Countries
    "United States", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "Canada", "India", 
    "France", "Spain", "Australia", "Netherlands", "Singapore",
    "Republic of Korea", "Brazil", "Japan", "United Arab Emirates", 
    "Mexico", "Poland", "Italy", "Switzerland", "Greece", "Malaysia",
    "China", "Denmark", "Israel", "Ireland", "Norway", "Sweden", 
    "Finland", "Austria",
    # 24 New Remote Residence Countries
    "Argentina", "Belgium", "Chile", "Colombia", "Czech Republic", "Egypt", 
    "Estonia", "Ghana", "Hungary", "Indonesia", "Kenya", "Latvia", 
    "Luxembourg", "New Zealand", "Nigeria", "Philippines", "Portugal", 
    "Romania", "Russia", "South Africa", "Thailand", "Turkey", "Ukraine", "Vietnam"
  ),
  
  # IMF WEO Oct 2024 (Projections for 2025 in USD Thousands)
  gdp_pc = c(
    89.105, 54.949, 55.911, 53.558, 2.878, 46.792, 36.192, 64.547, 70.480, 92.932, 
    34.642, 9.964, 33.956, 49.498, 12.692, 26.805, 41.091, 104.896, 25.756, 13.145, 
    13.687, 74.969, 57.760, 108.919, 89.694, 58.100, 54.163, 58.192, 
    14.362, 57.772, 17.015, 8.054, 33.039, 3.174, 32.760, 2.519, 24.809, 5.027, 
    2.468, 24.374, 140.941, 46.126, 0.807, 4.350, 30.002, 21.421, 14.258, 6.397, 
    7.767, 16.709, 6.261, 4.806
  ),
             
  # Numbeo 2025 Cost of Living Index
  cost_of_living = c(
    64.9, 59.2, 58.4, 58.7, 19.5, 58.0, 43.5, 60.9, 60.5, 79.1,
    56.5, 25.6, 45.6, 54.1, 34.5, 38.9, 51.0, 98.4, 46.5, 29.7,
    30.7, 66.9, 65.2, 59.8, 69.0, 54.2, 58.7, 60.7,
    35.7, 56.5, 35.1, 26.0, 42.6, 19.0, 49.4, 30.6, 36.6, 24.6, 
    28.2, 43.4, 64.8, 55.3, 26.4, 28.8, 41.2, 34.0, 22.3, 30.0, 
    33.7, 34.7, 24.6, 26.6
  ),
                   
  # Observer Global AI Index 2025 (Standardized to Overall Global Rank; 1 = Highest)
  tech_index = c(
    1, 4, 9, 8, 17, 6, 22, 21, 13, 3, 
    5, 25, 11, 10, 76, 37, 28, 12, 31, 24, 
    2, 18, 7, 23, 20, 19, 15, 32, 
    77, 33, 46, 53, 43, 47, 26, 61, 34, 45, 
    74, 60, 27, 35, 69, 48, 41, 50, 29, 54, 
    42, 49, 64, 40
  ),
  
  # INSEAD GTCI 2025 Index Scores
  human_capital_index = c(
    69.41, 67.52, 65.73, 66.40, 34.03, 62.88, 59.32, 69.27, 70.26, 73.29, 
    58.08, 44.04, 58.59, 59.36, 43.67, 53.70, 57.35, 73.14, 52.38, 50.20, 
    48.65, 72.05, 60.16, 68.73, 69.84, 70.76, 71.06, 65.86, 
    47.59, 66.05, 52.66, 43.94, 62.52, 36.62, 61.92, 33.43, 52.80, 41.18, 
    34.30, 54.59, 69.84, 64.16, 30.51, 42.39, 59.90, 48.24, 46.09, 41.19, 
    41.93, 40.96, 46.31, 42.25
  )
)

# 4. DATA PRE-PROCESSING, JOINING & ECONOMIC ARBITRAGE 

# ==============================================================================
# SUPERVISOR FEEDBACK #1: Capture Remote Work & Dual-Location Gaps
# Remark: "Introducing an economic arbitrage feature (e.g., ratio or distance between 
# company_location GDP/cost of living and employee_residence GDP/cost of living) 
# would capture cross-border remote pay adjustments."
# ==============================================================================

job_data <- job_data %>%
  mutate(
    company_location = case_when(
      company_location == "United States of America" ~ "United States",
      company_location == "South Korea" ~ "Republic of Korea",
      TRUE ~ company_location
    ),
    employee_residence = case_when(
      employee_residence == "United States of America" ~ "United States",
      employee_residence == "South Korea" ~ "Republic of Korea",
      TRUE ~ employee_residence
    )
  )

# A. Join Macro Data for the Company Location
job_data_econ <- job_data %>%
  left_join(econ_lookup, by = "company_location") %>%
  filter(!is.na(gdp_pc)) 

# B. Join Macro Data for the Employee Residence (to calculate Arbitrage)
econ_lookup_emp <- econ_lookup %>%
  rename(
    employee_residence = company_location,
    emp_gdp_pc = gdp_pc,
    emp_cost_of_living = cost_of_living
  ) %>%
  select(employee_residence, emp_gdp_pc, emp_cost_of_living)

job_data_econ <- job_data_econ %>%
  left_join(econ_lookup_emp, by = "employee_residence") %>%
  # Fallback logic retained strictly for unmapped future test data, 
  # but will not trigger for our defined 52 countries.
  mutate(
    emp_gdp_pc = ifelse(is.na(emp_gdp_pc), gdp_pc, emp_gdp_pc),
    emp_cost_of_living = ifelse(is.na(emp_cost_of_living), cost_of_living, emp_cost_of_living)
  ) %>%
  # C. Create Arbitrage Features based on Supervisor Feedback #1
  mutate(
    arbitrage_gdp_ratio = gdp_pc / emp_gdp_pc,
    arbitrage_col_ratio = cost_of_living / emp_cost_of_living
  )

# 5. CATEGORICAL TO NUMERICAL TRANSFORMATION
job_data_econ <- job_data_econ %>%
  mutate(
    company_size_num = case_when(
      company_size == "S" ~ 1,
      company_size == "M" ~ 2,
      company_size == "L" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    education_num = case_when(
      education_required == "Associate" ~ 1,
      education_required == "Bachelor"  ~ 2,
      education_required == "Master"    ~ 3,
      education_required == "PhD"       ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

industry_dummies <- model.matrix(~ industry - 1, data = job_data_econ)
colnames(industry_dummies) <- make.names(colnames(industry_dummies))
job_data_econ <- cbind(job_data_econ, industry_dummies)


# ==============================================================================
# 6. SPATIAL BLOCK CROSS-VALIDATION & MEM LEAKAGE PREVENTION
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# SUPERVISOR FEEDBACK #2: Refine the Economic Distance Metric
# Remark: "Replacing Euclidean distance with Mahalanobis distance (which accounts 
# for feature covariance) would yield a more realistic spatial connectivity weight W."
# 
# SUPERVISOR FEEDBACK #4: Prevent Potential Data Leakage in MEM Extraction
# Remark: "Ensure that MEM spatial eigenvectors are generated and selected strictly 
# within training folds and then projected onto validation folds, rather than 
# calculated across the entire dataset prior to splitting..."
#
# Implementation Note: The global Euclidean distance matrix creation has been 
# completely removed from this cleansing script. Mahalanobis distance calculation 
# and MEM extraction are deferred to the training loops in the modeling scripts.
# ==============================================================================


# ==============================================================================
# SUPERVISOR FEEDBACK #3: Adopt Spatial Block Cross-Validation
# Remark: "Implementing Spatial Block CV or Leave-One-Country-Out (LOCO) CV will 
# rigorously test the model's ability to generalize to entirely unseen countries 
# and regions."
# ==============================================================================
# ==============================================================================
# 6. SPATIAL BLOCK CROSS-VALIDATION (BALANCED LOCO)
# ==============================================================================
set.seed(123)
unique_countries <- unique(job_data_econ$company_location)

# Use rep() to ensure perfectly even distribution of the 20 countries across 5 folds
country_folds <- data.frame(
  company_location = unique_countries,
  fold = sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(unique_countries)))
)

job_data_econ <- job_data_econ %>%
  left_join(country_folds, by = "company_location")
```

```{r Data Cleansing (Stratified 5-Fold CV)}
  mutate(
    company_size_num = case_when(
      company_size == "S" ~ 1,
      company_size == "M" ~ 2,
      company_size == "L" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    education_num = case_when(
      education_required == "Associate" ~ 1,

    )

industry_dummies <- model.matrix(~ industry - 1, data = job_data_econ)
colnames(industry_dummies) <- make.names(colnames(industry_dummies))
job_data_econ <- cbind(job_data_econ, industry_dummies)


# ==============================================================================
# 6. STRATIFIED CROSS-VALIDATION (PREVIOUS APPROACH - SPATIAL INTERPOLATION)
# ==============================================================================

# Note: This removes Spatial Block CV (LOCO). It groups the data by country 
# and evenly distributes each country's rows across 5 folds, allowing the 
# model to "see" every country during training (Spatial Interpolation).

set.seed(123)
job_data_econ <- job_data_econ %>%
  group_by(company_location) %>%
  # sample(rep()) ensures that the 1-5 folds are distributed as evenly 
  # as possible within each country's specific row count
  mutate(fold = sample(rep(1:5, length.out = n()))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Double-check the fold distribution to ensure no data leakage was introduced mechanically
cat("Stratified 5-Fold Distribution Check:\n")
print(table(job_data_econ$fold))
```

```{r EDA}
# ==============================================================================
# EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS (EDA): GLOBAL AI SALARY DATASET
# ==============================================================================
# Ensures memory efficiency for 20GB Windows RAM constraints
gc() 

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(corrplot)
library(skimr)
library(gridExtra)

# 1. INITIAL DATA OVERVIEW & SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assuming the raw dataset is loaded as 'job_data_econ'
cat("=== Dataset Structure ===\n")
glimpse(job_data_econ)

cat("\n=== Comprehensive Statistical Summary ===\n")
# skimr provides a publication-ready summary for Master's level statistical reporting
skim(job_data_econ)

# Create the log-transformed target variable for comparison
job_data_econ <- job_data_econ %>%
  mutate(log_salary_usd = log(salary_usd))

# 2. TARGET VARIABLE DISTRIBUTIONS (RAW VS LOG-TRANSFORMED)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
p1 <- ggplot(job_data_econ, aes(x = salary_usd)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of AI Job Salaries (Raw USD)", 
       x = "Salary (USD)", y = "Frequency")

p2 <- ggplot(job_data_econ, aes(x = log_salary_usd)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkred", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of AI Job Salaries (Log-Transformed)", 
       x = "Log(Salary USD)", y = "Frequency")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)

# 3. CORRELATION ANALYSIS (CONTINUOUS & MACRO VARIABLES)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Select numerical features central to the comb_1 to comb_4 ablation combinations
continuous_vars <- job_data_econ %>%
  select(salary_usd, log_salary_usd, years_experience, remote_ratio, 
         company_size_num, education_num, benefits_score, 
         gdp_pc, cost_of_living, tech_index, human_capital_index) %>%
  na.omit()

cor_matrix <- cor(continuous_vars, method = "pearson")

# Generate a visually intuitive correlation plot for thesis reporting
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", 
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, addCoef.col = "black", 
         number.cex = 0.7, diag = FALSE, 
         title = "Pearson Correlation Matrix of AI Salary and Economic Indicators",
         mar = c(0,0,1,0))

# 4. MACROECONOMIC RELATIONSHIPS (BIVARIATE ANALYSIS)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evaluating how base economic structures (comb_1 & comb_2) correlate with log wages
p3 <- ggplot(job_data_econ, aes(x = gdp_pc, y = log_salary_usd)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "purple") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Log Salary vs. GDP per Capita (comb_1 base)", 
       x = "GDP per Capita", y = "Log(Salary USD)")

p4 <- ggplot(job_data_econ, aes(x = cost_of_living, y = log_salary_usd)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Log Salary vs. Cost of Living", 
       x = "Cost of Living Index", y = "Log(Salary USD)")

grid.arrange(p3, p4, ncol = 2)

# 5. SPATIAL / GEOGRAPHIC WAGE DISPERSION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Boxplot of log salaries across the 20 country locations
# Ordered by median salary to highlight structural global inequalities
ggplot(job_data_econ, aes(x = reorder(company_location, log_salary_usd, FUN = median), 
                          y = log_salary_usd)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.6, outlier.color = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Global AI Compensation Distribution by Country",
       subtitle = "Ranked by Median Log Salary",
       x = "Company Location",
       y = "Log(Salary USD)") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

# Clean up memory allocation after EDA execution
gc()
```

```{r Feature Selection}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Feature Exclusion Diagnostics 
# PURPOSE: To mathematically justify the removal of non-predictive variables
# ==============================================================================

# 1. LOAD LIBRARIES & DATA
library(dplyr)
library(stats)

file_path <- "C:/Users/user/Desktop/UM/OneDrive - Universiti Malaya/SQB7038 Research Project/Dataset/Global AI Job Market & Salary Trends 2025/ai_job_dataset1.csv"
job_data <- read.csv(file_path)
n_rows <- nrow(job_data)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. HIGH CARDINALITY (job_id, required_skills)
# ==============================================================================
# Calculate cardinality ratio: Unique values / Total Rows
unique_job_id <- length(unique(job_data$job_id))
unique_skills <- length(unique(job_data$required_skills))

cat("Cardinality Ratio for job_id:", unique_job_id / n_rows, 
    "(", unique_job_id, "unique values across", n_rows, "rows )\n")
cat("Cardinality Ratio for required_skills:", unique_skills / n_rows, 
    "(", unique_skills, "unique values across", n_rows, "rows )\n\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 3. SPATIAL REDUNDANCY (employee_residence vs company_location)
# ==============================================================================
# Calculate direct identity match rate
match_count <- sum(job_data$company_location == job_data$employee_residence)
cat("Spatial Redundancy Match Rate:", round((match_count / n_rows) * 100, 2), "%\n\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 4. STRUCTURAL MULTICOLLINEARITY (One-Way ANOVA)
# ==============================================================================
# Compare continuous years_experience across categorical experience_level
anova_exp <- aov(years_experience ~ experience_level, data = job_data)
cat("ANOVA - years_experience vs experience_level:\n")
print(summary(anova_exp)) # Yields F-value and p-value
cat("\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 5. PERFECT MULTICOLLINEARITY / DATA LEAKAGE (Pearson)
# ==============================================================================
# Filter for USD to test exact collinearity without exchange rate noise
usd_data <- job_data %>% filter(salary_currency == "USD")
corr_salary <- cor(usd_data$salary_usd, usd_data$salary_local, method = "pearson")
cat("Pearson Correlation (salary_usd & salary_local in USD):", corr_salary, "\n\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 6. TEMPORAL & ADMINISTRATIVE ARTIFACTS (Pearson)
# ==============================================================================
# # Convert dates to numerical timestamps (seconds since epoch) to calculate linear correlation
# job_data$posting_ts <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(job_data$posting_date))
# job_data$deadline_ts <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(job_data$application_deadline))
# 
# corr_length <- cor(job_data$salary_usd, job_data$job_description_length, method = "pearson")
# corr_posting <- cor(job_data$salary_usd, job_data$posting_ts, method = "pearson")
# corr_deadline <- cor(job_data$salary_usd, job_data$deadline_ts, method = "pearson")
# 
# cat("Pearson Correlation - job_description_length:", corr_length, "\n")
# cat("Pearson Correlation - posting_date (timestamp):", corr_posting, "\n")
# cat("Pearson Correlation - application_deadline (timestamp):", corr_deadline, "\n\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 7. NON-PREDICTIVE NOMINAL GROUPINGS (Univariate Categorical Regression)
# ==============================================================================
# Function to cleanly extract R-squared and overall p-value from linear model
extract_regression_metrics <- function(model_summary) {
  r_squared <- model_summary$r.squared
  f_stat <- model_summary$fstatistic
  
  # Calculate p-value and forcefully strip hidden names using unname()
  p_value <- unname(pf(f_stat[1], f_stat[2], f_stat[3], lower.tail = FALSE))
  
  # Return with clean names
  return(c(R_squared = r_squared, p_value = p_value))
}

# 7A. Regression for job_title
lm_job_title <- lm(salary_usd ~ job_title, data = job_data)
summary_job <- summary(lm_job_title)
metrics_job <- extract_regression_metrics(summary_job)

cat("Categorical Regression - job_title:\n")
cat("R-squared:", round(metrics_job["R_squared"], 4), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(metrics_job["p_value"], 4), "\n\n")

# 7B. Regression for employment_type
lm_emp_type <- lm(salary_usd ~ employment_type, data = job_data)
summary_emp <- summary(lm_emp_type)
metrics_emp <- extract_regression_metrics(summary_emp)

cat("Categorical Regression - employment_type:\n")
cat("R-squared:", round(metrics_emp["R_squared"], 4), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(metrics_emp["p_value"], 4), "\n")
```

```{r General Spatial Effect Analysis}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Multi-Combination Economic ESDA (comb_1 to comb_4)
# PURPOSE: Calculate Global Moran's I and generate outputs separately for each combination
# ==============================================================================

# 1. LOAD REQUIRED LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(sf)           # For handling spatial geometries
library(spdep)        # For spatial weights and Moran's I calculation
library(rnaturalearth)# For global country polygons and coordinates
library(ggplot2)      # For choropleth mapping

# 2. LOAD AND PREPARE THE DATA
file_path <- "C:/Users/user/Desktop/UM/OneDrive - Universiti Malaya/SQB7038 Research Project/Dataset/Global AI Job Market & Salary Trends 2025/ai_job_dataset1.csv"
job_data <- read.csv(file_path)

# Harmonize country names to match rnaturalearth 'admin' field exactly
job_data <- job_data %>%
  mutate(company_location = case_when(
    company_location == "United States of America" ~ "United States",

  ))

# 3. DEFINE ECONOMIC VALUES & ABLATION COMBINATIONS
econ_lookup <- data.frame(
  company_location = c("United States", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "Canada", "India", 
                       "France", "Spain", "Australia", "Netherlands", "Singapore",
                       "Republic of Korea", "Brazil", "Japan", "United Arab Emirates",

  gdp_pc              = c(95.2, 61.1, 65.7, 58.4, 2.8, 50.5, 37.1, 71.3, 70.2, 109.1, 
                          37.5, 12.5, 36.2, 57.1, 17.5, 25.4, 42.0, 110.5, 26.5, 15.0,
                          15.5, 75.0, 58.0, 115.0, 95.0, 60.5, 57.0, 62.5),
  cost_of_living      = c(64.9, 59.2, 58.4, 58.7, 19.5, 58.0, 43.5, 60.9, 60.5, 79.1,
                          56.5, 25.6, 45.6, 54.1, 34.5, 38.9, 51.0, 98.4, 46.5, 29.7,
                          30.7, 66.9, 65.2, 59.8, 69.0, 54.2, 58.7, 60.7),
  tech_index          = c(100.0, 38.0, 25.0, 28.5, 21.0, 24.5, 19.5, 21.0, 22.0, 35.0,
                          26.5, 17.5, 24.0, 23.5, 14.5, 15.5, 21.5, 25.5, 13.5, 14.5,
                          60.0, 21.5, 29.0, 19.5, 20.5, 22.5, 23.5, 19.0),
  human_capital_index = c(75, 74, 72, 73, 45, 71, 68, 75, 77, 80,
                          70, 48, 71, 65, 47, 62, 66, 79, 60, 61,
                          55, 78, 70, 74, 76, 77, 78, 72)
)

macro_combinations <- list(
  comb_1 = c("gdp_pc"),
  comb_2 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living"),
  comb_3 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index"),
  comb_4 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index", "human_capital_index")
)

# Aggregate country summary dataset
country_summary <- job_data %>%
  left_join(econ_lookup, by = "company_location") %>%
  group_by(company_location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_raw_salary     = mean(salary_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    gdp_pc              = first(gdp_pc),
    cost_of_living      = first(cost_of_living),
    tech_index          = first(tech_index),
    human_capital_index = first(human_capital_index),
    job_count           = n()
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gdp_pc))

# Load world map for spatial joining
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# ==============================================================================
# 4. ITERATE THROUGH COMBINATIONS SEPARATELY
# ==============================================================================
for (comb_name in names(macro_combinations)) {
  current_vars <- macro_combinations[[comb_name]]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n====================================================\n"))
  cat(sprintf(" ESDA: GLOBAL MORAN'S I (%s)\n", comb_name))
  cat(sprintf("====================================================\n"))
  
  # Scale features for the current combination
  econ_scaled <- scale(country_summary[, current_vars, drop = FALSE])
  
  # Compute Euclidean distance matrix
  econ_dist <- as.matrix(dist(econ_scaled, method = "euclidean"))
  rownames(econ_dist) <- country_summary$company_location
  colnames(econ_dist) <- country_summary$company_location
  
  # Create KNN weights matrix (k = 3)
  knn_econ <- knearneigh(econ_dist, k = 3)
  nb_econ <- knn2nb(knn_econ)
  weights_matrix_econ <- nb2listw(nb_econ, style = "W")
  
  # Calculate Moran's I
  moran_res <- moran.test(country_summary$mean_raw_salary, weights_matrix_econ)
  print(moran_res)
  
  # Generate & Save Moran Scatter Plot
  plot_filename_scatter <- paste0("moran_scatterplot_", comb_name, ".png")
  png(plot_filename_scatter, width = 800, height = 800, res = 120)
  moran.plot(country_summary$mean_raw_salary, weights_matrix_econ, 
             xlab = "Standardized Raw Salary (Country)",
             ylab = paste0("Economic Lag (", comb_name, ")"),
             main = paste0("Moran Scatter Plot - ", comb_name))
  dev.off()
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", plot_filename_scatter))
  
  # Generate & Save Choropleth Map
  spatial_salary <- world %>%
    left_join(country_summary, by = c("admin" = "company_location")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_raw_salary))
  
  map_plot <- ggplot(spatial_salary) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_raw_salary), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Mean Raw Salary (USD)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Global Distribution of AI Salaries (", comb_name, ")"),
      subtitle = "Aggregated Mean Salary Across Mapped Countries",
      caption = "Source: Study Dataset Economic ESDA Analysis"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  plot_filename_map <- paste0("global_salary_choropleth_", comb_name, ".png")
  ggsave(plot_filename_map, plot = map_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n\n", plot_filename_map))
}
```

```{r Spatial Random Forest with Economic Distance (Enhance)}
# ==============================================================================
# ABLATION STUDY: SPATIAL RANDOM FOREST (RAW VS LOG) - NESTED CV ENHANCED
# (Updated with Distance Toggle, Fold-Isolated MEMs, Spatial Block CV, & Row-Level Moran's I)
# ==============================================================================
library(ranger)
library(spatialRF)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)   # Required for Moran's I
library(stats) # Required for cov()

# --- NEW: DISTANCE TOGGLE ---
distance_method <- "mahalanobis" # Change to "mahalanobis" to toggle distance calculation

# 0. DEFINE ABLATION COMBINATIONS & PREPARE STORAGE
macro_combinations <- list(
  comb_1 = c("gdp_pc"),
  comb_2 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living"),
  comb_3 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index"),
  comb_4 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index", "human_capital_index")
)

ablation_results_srf <- data.frame(
  Combination = character(), Model = character(), 
  RMSE = numeric(), R_Squared = numeric(), 
  Morans_I_Obs = numeric(), Morans_I_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Base predictors (Including Economic Arbitrage Features from Feedback #1)
base_predictors <- c("years_experience", "remote_ratio", "benefits_score", 
                     "company_size_num", "education_num", 
                     "arbitrage_gdp_ratio", "arbitrage_col_ratio",
                     colnames(industry_dummies))

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE HYPERPARAMETER TUNING FUNCTION 
# ==============================================================================
tune_spatial_rf <- function(dependent_var, data, predictors_list) {
  total_features <- length(predictors_list)
  mtry_vals <- unique(floor(c(2, sqrt(total_features), total_features/3, total_features/2)))
  
  param_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_vals, min.node.size = c(3, 5, 10, 15))
  best_mse <- Inf
  best_params <- NULL
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
    fit <- ranger(
      dependent.variable.name = dependent_var,
      data = data[, c(dependent_var, predictors_list)],
      num.trees = 500,
      mtry = param_grid$mtry[i],
      min.node.size = param_grid$min.node.size[i],
      seed = 123
    )
    if(fit$prediction.error < best_mse) {
      best_mse <- fit$prediction.error
      best_params <- param_grid[i, ]
    }
  }
  return(best_params)
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAFE MEM EXTRACTION FUNCTION (Handles "length 0" optimization crashes)
# ==============================================================================
safe_extract_mems <- function(train_country_summary, dep_var, agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds) {
  result <- tryCatch({
    model_econ <- rf_spatial(
      data = train_country_summary,
      dependent.variable.name = dep_var,
      predictor.variable.names = agg_predictors,
      distance.matrix = train_dist_matrix,
      distance.thresholds = adjusted_thresholds, 
      method = "mem.moran.sequential",     
      n.cores = 3,  
      seed = 123,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    if (ncol(model_econ$spatial$spatial.predictors) == 0) stop("Zero MEMs selected")
    return(model_econ$spatial$spatial.predictors)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("    [Notice] Sequential MEM optimization failed or returned 0 MEMs. Falling back to global eigenvectors.\n")
    inv_weights <- 1 / (train_dist_matrix + 1e-6)
    diag(inv_weights) <- 0
    n <- nrow(inv_weights)
    centering_matrix <- diag(n) - matrix(1/n, n, n)
    centered_weights <- centering_matrix %*% inv_weights %*% centering_matrix
    eigen_decomp <- eigen(centered_weights, symmetric = TRUE)
    positive_idx <- which(eigen_decomp$values > 1e-8)
    if(length(positive_idx) > 5) positive_idx <- positive_idx[1:5]
    fallback_mems <- data.frame(eigen_decomp$vectors[, positive_idx])
    colnames(fallback_mems) <- paste0("spatial_predictor_", 1:ncol(fallback_mems))
    return(fallback_mems)
  })
  return(result)
}

# ==============================================================================
# START ABLATION LOOP
# ==============================================================================
for (comb_name in names(macro_combinations)) {
  current_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[[comb_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n=== RUNNING ABLATION: %s (%d Variables) ===\n", comb_name, length(current_macro_vars)))
  
  # Ensure clean target columns per iteration
  current_job_data <- job_data_econ %>% select(-starts_with("spatial_predictor_"))
  current_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(current_job_data$salary_usd)
  current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_raw <- NA
  current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_log <- NA
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # SPATIAL BLOCK CV LOOP (LOCO)
  # ==============================================================================
  cat("Running Spatial Block 5-Fold CV (LOCO) with Fold-Isolated MEMs...\n")
  
  for(f in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- which(current_job_data$fold != f)
    test_idx  <- which(current_job_data$fold == f)
    
    cat("  -> Processing Fold", f, "(Train:", length(train_idx), "rows, Test:", length(test_idx), "rows)\n")
    
    train_data <- current_job_data[train_idx, ]
    test_data  <- current_job_data[test_idx, ]
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 1: CALCULATE DISTANCE MATRIX ONLY ON TRAINING DATA 
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    train_country_summary <- train_data %>%
      group_by(company_location) %>%
      summarise(
        salary_usd = mean(salary_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
        log_salary_usd = mean(log_salary_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
        years_experience = mean(years_experience, na.rm = TRUE),
        remote_ratio = mean(remote_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
        benefits_score = mean(benefits_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        company_size_num = mean(company_size_num, na.rm = TRUE),
        education_num = mean(education_num, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
      
    macro_summary <- econ_lookup %>% filter(company_location %in% train_country_summary$company_location)
    train_country_summary <- train_country_summary %>% left_join(macro_summary[, c("company_location", current_macro_vars)], by = "company_location")
    
    macro_mat_train <- as.matrix(train_country_summary[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
    train_dist_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(train_country_summary), ncol = nrow(train_country_summary))
    
    if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
      cov_matrix_train <- cov(macro_mat_train)
      if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_train <- matrix(cov_matrix_train, 1, 1)
      diag(cov_matrix_train) <- diag(cov_matrix_train) + 1e-6 
      inv_cov_matrix_train <- solve(cov_matrix_train)
      
      for(i in 1:nrow(train_country_summary)) {
        diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_train[i, ]), "-")
        train_dist_matrix[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_train) * diff_matrix))
      }
    } else {
      # Default to Euclidean Distance
      for(i in 1:nrow(train_country_summary)) {
        diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_train[i, ]), "-")
        train_dist_matrix[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
      }
    }
    rownames(train_dist_matrix) <- train_country_summary$company_location
    colnames(train_dist_matrix) <- train_country_summary$company_location
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 2: EXTRACT FOLD-ISOLATED MEMS 
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    agg_predictors <- c("years_experience", "remote_ratio", "benefits_score", 
                        "company_size_num", "education_num")
    
    min_dist <- min(train_dist_matrix[train_dist_matrix > 0])
    max_dist <- max(train_dist_matrix)
    adjusted_thresholds <- seq(from = min_dist, to = max_dist / 2, length.out = 5)
    
    # Safe Extract MEMs for Raw target
    raw_mems <- safe_extract_mems(train_country_summary, "salary_usd", agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds)
    spatial_features_train_raw <- data.frame(company_location = train_country_summary$company_location, raw_mems)
    colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1], "_raw")
    spatial_vars_raw <- colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1]
    
    # Safe Extract MEMs for Log target
    log_mems <- safe_extract_mems(train_country_summary, "log_salary_usd", agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds)
    spatial_features_train_log <- data.frame(company_location = train_country_summary$company_location, log_mems)
    colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1], "_log")
    spatial_vars_log <- colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1]
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 3: PROJECT MEMS ONTO TEST DATA (Zero Data Leakage)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    unique_test_countries <- unique(test_data$company_location)
    spatial_features_test_raw <- data.frame(company_location = unique_test_countries)
    spatial_features_test_log <- data.frame(company_location = unique_test_countries)
    
    for (sv in spatial_vars_raw) spatial_features_test_raw[[sv]] <- NA
    for (sv in spatial_vars_log) spatial_features_test_log[[sv]] <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:length(unique_test_countries)) {
      test_country <- unique_test_countries[i]
      test_country_macro <- as.matrix(econ_lookup[econ_lookup$company_location == test_country, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
      
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(test_country_macro), "-")
      
      if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
        dist_to_train <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_train) * diff_matrix))
      } else {
        dist_to_train <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
      }
      
      inv_weights <- 1 / (dist_to_train + 1e-6)
      normalized_weights <- inv_weights / sum(inv_weights)
      
      for (sv in spatial_vars_raw) {
        spatial_features_test_raw[i, sv] <- sum(spatial_features_train_raw[[sv]] * normalized_weights)
      }
      for (sv in spatial_vars_log) {
        spatial_features_test_log[i, sv] <- sum(spatial_features_train_log[[sv]] * normalized_weights)
      }
    }
    
    train_data <- train_data %>% 
      left_join(spatial_features_train_raw, by = "company_location") %>%
      left_join(spatial_features_train_log, by = "company_location")
      
    test_data <- test_data %>% 
      left_join(spatial_features_test_raw, by = "company_location") %>%
      left_join(spatial_features_test_log, by = "company_location")
    
    all_predictors_raw <- c(base_predictors, current_macro_vars, spatial_vars_raw)
    all_predictors_log <- c(base_predictors, current_macro_vars, spatial_vars_log)
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 4: TUNE & TRAIN EXCLUSIVELY ON THE TRAINING FOLD
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    best_params_raw <- tune_spatial_rf("salary_usd", train_data, all_predictors_raw)
    best_params_log <- tune_spatial_rf("log_salary_usd", train_data, all_predictors_log)
    
    model_cv_raw <- ranger(
      dependent.variable.name = "salary_usd",
      data = train_data[, c("salary_usd", all_predictors_raw)],
      num.trees = 500, mtry = best_params_raw$mtry, min.node.size = best_params_raw$min.node.size, seed = 123
    )
    
    model_cv_log <- ranger(
      dependent.variable.name = "log_salary_usd",
      data = train_data[, c("log_salary_usd", all_predictors_log)],
      num.trees = 500, mtry = best_params_log$mtry, min.node.size = best_params_log$min.node.size, seed = 123
    )
    
    current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_raw[test_idx] <- predict(model_cv_raw, data = test_data)$predictions
    current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_log[test_idx] <- exp(predict(model_cv_log, data = test_data)$predictions)
  }
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # EVALUATION: INDIVIDUAL ROW LEVEL (15,000 Records - Weighted by Dataset Composition)
  # ==============================================================================
  cat("Evaluating Metrics and Residual Autocorrelation on full dataset...\n")
  
  # 1. Calculate overall RMSE and R-Squared at the individual row level
  resids_raw <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_raw
  resids_log <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_rf_spatial_log
  
  r2_raw <- 1 - (sum(resids_raw^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  r2_log <- 1 - (sum(resids_log^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(mean(resids_raw^2))
  rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(resids_log^2))
  
  # 2. Build Full Row-Level Distance Matrix based on selected method
  macro_mat_full <- as.matrix(current_job_data[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
  full_mahalanobis_dist <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(current_job_data), ncol = nrow(current_job_data))
  
  if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
    cov_matrix_full <- cov(macro_mat_full)
    if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_full <- matrix(cov_matrix_full, 1, 1)
    diag(cov_matrix_full) <- diag(cov_matrix_full) + 1e-6 
    inv_cov_matrix_full <- solve(cov_matrix_full)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_full) * diff_matrix))
    }
  } else {
    # Default to Euclidean Distance
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. THE ROW-LEVEL FIX: Use 1 / (Distance + 1)
  # This prevents 1/0 = Inf. Workers in the same country (Distance 0) get a max weight of 1.
  inv_dist_weights_full <- 1 / (full_mahalanobis_dist + 1)
  diag(inv_dist_weights_full) <- 0 # A row cannot be its own neighbor
  
  # 4. Calculate Moran's I on all ~15,000 residuals
  moran_raw <- Moran.I(resids_raw, inv_dist_weights_full)
  moran_log <- Moran.I(resids_log, inv_dist_weights_full)
  
  ablation_results_srf <- rbind(
    ablation_results_srf,
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Spatial RF (Raw)", RMSE = rmse_raw, R_Squared = r2_raw, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_raw$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_raw$p.value),
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Spatial RF (Log)", RMSE = rmse_log, R_Squared = r2_log, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_log$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_log$p.value)
  )
}

print(ablation_results_srf)
```



```{r Normal Random Forest}
# ==============================================================================
# ABLATION STUDY: NORMAL RANDOM FOREST (RAW VS LOG) - NESTED CV ENHANCED
# (Updated with Distance Toggle, Spatial Block CV & Row-Level Moran's I Evaluation)
# ==============================================================================
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)   # Required for Moran's I
library(stats) # Required for cov()

# --- NEW: DISTANCE TOGGLE ---
distance_method <- "mahalanobis" # Change to "mahalanobis" to toggle distance calculation

# 0. DEFINE ABLATION COMBINATIONS & PREPARE STORAGE
macro_combinations <- list(
  comb_1 = c("gdp_pc"),
  comb_2 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living"),
  comb_3 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index"),
  comb_4 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index", "human_capital_index")
)

ablation_results_nrf <- data.frame(
  Combination = character(), Model = character(), 
  RMSE = numeric(), R_Squared = numeric(), 
  Morans_I_Obs = numeric(), Morans_I_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Base predictors (Including Economic Arbitrage from Feedback #1)
base_features_str <- paste(
  "years_experience", "remote_ratio", "company_size_num", 
  "education_num", "benefits_score", 
  "arbitrage_gdp_ratio", "arbitrage_col_ratio",
  paste(colnames(industry_dummies), collapse = " + "), 
  sep = " + "
)

# ==============================================================================
# START NORMAL RF ABLATION LOOP
# ==============================================================================
for (comb_name in names(macro_combinations)) {
  current_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[[comb_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n=== RUNNING NORMAL RF ABLATION: %s (%d Variables) ===\n", comb_name, length(current_macro_vars)))
  
  current_job_data <- job_data_econ
  current_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(current_job_data$salary_usd)
  current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_raw <- NA
  current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_log <- NA
  
  # --- A. DYNAMICALLY CONSTRUCT FORMULAS ---
  macro_features_str <- paste(current_macro_vars, collapse = " + ")
  full_features_str <- paste(base_features_str, "+", macro_features_str)
  
  rf_formula_raw <- as.formula(paste("salary_usd ~", full_features_str))
  rf_formula_log <- as.formula(paste("log_salary_usd ~", full_features_str))

  # --- B. DEFINE TUNING GRID & FUNCTION ---
  total_features <- 7 + length(colnames(industry_dummies)) + length(current_macro_vars)
  mtry_vals <- unique(floor(c(2, sqrt(total_features), total_features/3, total_features/2)))
  param_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_vals, min.node.size = c(3, 5, 10, 15))
  
  tune_rf <- function(formula, data) {
    best_mse <- Inf
    best_params <- NULL
    for(i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
      fit <- ranger(formula = formula, data = data, num.trees = 500,
                    mtry = param_grid$mtry[i], min.node.size = param_grid$min.node.size[i], seed = 123)
      if(fit$prediction.error < best_mse) {
        best_mse <- fit$prediction.error
        best_params <- param_grid[i, ]
      }
    }
    return(best_params)
  }
  
  # --- C. TRAIN MODELS VIA NESTED 5-FOLD SPATIAL BLOCK CV (LOCO) ---
  cat("Running Nested 5-Fold CV (LOCO)...\n")
  for(f in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- which(current_job_data$fold != f)
    test_idx  <- which(current_job_data$fold == f)
    
    cat("  -> Tuning & Training Fold", f, "...\n")
    train_data <- current_job_data[train_idx, ]
    
    # 1. TUNE EXCLUSIVELY ON THE TRAINING FOLD
    best_params_raw <- tune_rf(rf_formula_raw, train_data)
    best_params_log <- tune_rf(rf_formula_log, train_data)
    
    # 2. TRAIN RAW MODEL WITH TUNED PARAMS
    model_normal_raw_fold <- ranger(
      formula = rf_formula_raw, data = train_data, num.trees = 500,
      mtry = best_params_raw$mtry, min.node.size = best_params_raw$min.node.size, seed = 123
    )
    current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_raw[test_idx] <- predict(model_normal_raw_fold, data = current_job_data[test_idx, ])$predictions
    
    # 3. TRAIN LOG MODEL WITH TUNED PARAMS
    model_normal_log_fold <- ranger(
      formula = rf_formula_log, data = train_data, num.trees = 500,
      mtry = best_params_log$mtry, min.node.size = best_params_log$min.node.size, seed = 123
    )
    current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_log[test_idx] <- exp(predict(model_normal_log_fold, data = current_job_data[test_idx, ])$predictions)
  }
  
  # --- D. EVALUATION: INDIVIDUAL ROW LEVEL (15,000 Records - Weighted by Dataset Composition) ---
  cat("Evaluating Metrics and Residual Autocorrelation on full dataset...\n")
  
  # 1. Calculate overall RMSE and R-Squared at the individual row level
  resids_raw <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_raw
  resids_log <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_rf_normal_log
  
  r2_raw <- 1 - (sum(resids_raw^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  r2_log <- 1 - (sum(resids_log^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(mean(resids_raw^2))
  rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(resids_log^2))
  
  # 2. Build Full Row-Level Distance Matrix based on selected method
  macro_mat_full <- as.matrix(current_job_data[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
  full_mahalanobis_dist <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(current_job_data), ncol = nrow(current_job_data))
  
  if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
    cov_matrix_full <- cov(macro_mat_full)
    if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_full <- matrix(cov_matrix_full, 1, 1)
    diag(cov_matrix_full) <- diag(cov_matrix_full) + 1e-6 
    inv_cov_matrix_full <- solve(cov_matrix_full)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_full) * diff_matrix))
    }
  } else {
    # Default to Euclidean Distance
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. THE ROW-LEVEL FIX: Use 1 / (Distance + 1)
  # This prevents 1/0 = Inf. Workers in the same country (Distance 0) get a max weight of 1.
  inv_dist_weights_full <- 1 / (full_mahalanobis_dist + 1)
  diag(inv_dist_weights_full) <- 0 # A row cannot be its own neighbor
  
  # 4. Calculate Moran's I on all ~15,000 residuals
  moran_raw <- Moran.I(resids_raw, inv_dist_weights_full)
  moran_log <- Moran.I(resids_log, inv_dist_weights_full)
  
  ablation_results_nrf <- rbind(
    ablation_results_nrf,
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Normal RF (Raw)", RMSE = rmse_raw, R_Squared = r2_raw, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_raw$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_raw$p.value),
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Normal RF (Log)", RMSE = rmse_log, R_Squared = r2_log, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_log$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_log$p.value)
  )
}

print(ablation_results_nrf)
```

```{r MEM XGBoost}
# ==============================================================================
# ABLATION STUDY: SPATIAL XGBOOST (RAW VS LOG) - NESTED CV ENHANCED
# (Updated with Distance Toggle, Spatial Block CV, MEM Projection & Row-Level Evaluation)
# ==============================================================================
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)
library(spatialRF)
library(ape)   # Added ape for consistent Moran's I evaluation
library(stats) # Required for cov()

# --- NEW: DISTANCE TOGGLE ---
distance_method <- "mahalanobis" # Change to "mahalanobis" to toggle distance calculation

# 0. DEFINE ABLATION COMBINATIONS & STORAGE
macro_combinations <- list(
  comb_1 = c("gdp_pc"),
  comb_2 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living"),
  comb_3 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index"),
  comb_4 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index", "human_capital_index")
)

ablation_results_sxgb <- data.frame(
  Combination = character(), Model = character(), 
  RMSE = numeric(), R_Squared = numeric(), 
  Morans_I_Obs = numeric(), Morans_I_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Base predictors (Including Economic Arbitrage Features)
industry_cols <- colnames(industry_dummies)
base_features <- c("years_experience", "remote_ratio", "company_size_num", 
                   "education_num", "benefits_score", 
                   "arbitrage_gdp_ratio", "arbitrage_col_ratio", industry_cols)

# ==============================================================================
# SAFE MEM EXTRACTION FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================
safe_extract_mems <- function(train_country_summary, dep_var, agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds) {
  result <- tryCatch({
    model_econ <- rf_spatial(
      data = train_country_summary, dependent.variable.name = dep_var, predictor.variable.names = agg_predictors,
      distance.matrix = train_dist_matrix, distance.thresholds = adjusted_thresholds, 
      method = "mem.moran.sequential", n.cores = 3, seed = 123, verbose = FALSE
    )
    if (ncol(model_econ$spatial$spatial.predictors) == 0) stop("Zero MEMs selected")
    return(model_econ$spatial$spatial.predictors)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("    [Notice] Sequential MEM optimization failed or returned 0 MEMs. Falling back to global eigenvectors.\n")
    inv_weights <- 1 / (train_dist_matrix + 1e-6)
    diag(inv_weights) <- 0
    n <- nrow(inv_weights)
    centering_matrix <- diag(n) - matrix(1/n, n, n)
    centered_weights <- centering_matrix %*% inv_weights %*% centering_matrix
    eigen_decomp <- eigen(centered_weights, symmetric = TRUE)
    positive_idx <- which(eigen_decomp$values > 1e-8)
    if(length(positive_idx) > 5) positive_idx <- positive_idx[1:5]
    fallback_mems <- data.frame(eigen_decomp$vectors[, positive_idx])
    colnames(fallback_mems) <- paste0("spatial_predictor_", 1:ncol(fallback_mems))
    return(fallback_mems)
  })
  return(result)
}

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE HYPERPARAMETER TUNING FUNCTION (STRATIFIED INNER 3-FOLD)
# ==============================================================================
tune_xgb <- function(X, y, train_locations) {
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y)
  best_rmse <- Inf
  best_params <- NULL
  best_nrounds <- 100 
  
  set.seed(123) 
  inner_fold_assign <- data.frame(location = train_locations, row_id = 1:nrow(X)) %>%
    group_by(location) %>%
    mutate(inner_fold = sample(rep(1:3, length.out = n()))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  custom_cv_folds <- list(
    Fold1 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 1),
    Fold2 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 2),
    Fold3 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 3)
  )
  
  param_grid <- expand.grid(max_depth = c(3, 5, 7), eta = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1), min_child_weight = c(1, 3, 5))
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
    params <- list(objective = "reg:squarederror", max_depth = param_grid$max_depth[i],
                   eta = param_grid$eta[i], min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
                   subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8, seed = 123)
    
    cv_res <- xgb.cv(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 1000, folds = custom_cv_folds,
                     early_stopping_rounds = 20, metrics = "rmse", verbose = 0)
    
    current_rmse <- min(cv_res$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
    opt_nrounds <- if(!is.null(cv_res$best_iteration) && length(cv_res$best_iteration) > 0 && cv_res$best_iteration > 0) {
      cv_res$best_iteration
    } else {
      which.min(cv_res$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
    }
    
    if(current_rmse < best_rmse) {
      best_rmse <- current_rmse
      best_params <- params
      best_nrounds <- opt_nrounds
    }
  }
  best_params$nrounds <- as.integer(best_nrounds)
  return(best_params)
}

# ==============================================================================
# START SPATIAL XGBOOST ABLATION LOOP
# ==============================================================================
for (comb_name in names(macro_combinations)) {
  current_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[[comb_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n=== RUNNING SPATIAL XGBOOST ABLATION: %s (%d Variables) ===\n", comb_name, length(current_macro_vars)))
  
  current_job_data <- as.data.frame(job_data_econ) %>% select(-starts_with("spatial_predictor_"))
  current_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(current_job_data$salary_usd)
  current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_raw <- NA
  current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_log <- NA
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # TRAIN MODELS VIA SPATIAL BLOCK CV (LOCO) & FOLD-ISOLATED MEMS
  # ==============================================================================
  cat("Running Spatial Block 5-Fold CV (LOCO)...\n")
  for(f in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- which(current_job_data$fold != f)
    test_idx  <- which(current_job_data$fold == f)
    
    cat("  -> Processing Fold", f, "(Train:", length(train_idx), "rows, Test:", length(test_idx), "rows)\n")
    train_data <- current_job_data[train_idx, ]
    test_data  <- current_job_data[test_idx, ]
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. CALCULATE DISTANCE MATRIX ON TRAINING DATA
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    train_country_summary <- train_data %>%
      group_by(company_location) %>%
      summarise(
        salary_usd = mean(salary_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
        log_salary_usd = mean(log_salary_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
        years_experience = mean(years_experience, na.rm = TRUE),
        remote_ratio = mean(remote_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
        benefits_score = mean(benefits_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        company_size_num = mean(company_size_num, na.rm = TRUE),
        education_num = mean(education_num, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
      
    macro_summary <- econ_lookup %>% filter(company_location %in% train_country_summary$company_location)
    train_country_summary <- train_country_summary %>% left_join(macro_summary[, c("company_location", current_macro_vars)], by = "company_location")
    
    macro_mat_train <- as.matrix(train_country_summary[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
    train_dist_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(train_country_summary), ncol = nrow(train_country_summary))
    
    if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
      cov_matrix_train <- cov(macro_mat_train)
      if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_train <- matrix(cov_matrix_train, 1, 1)
      diag(cov_matrix_train) <- diag(cov_matrix_train) + 1e-6 
      inv_cov_matrix_train <- solve(cov_matrix_train)
      
      for(i in 1:nrow(train_country_summary)) {
        diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_train[i, ]), "-")
        train_dist_matrix[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_train) * diff_matrix))
      }
    } else {
      # Default to Euclidean Distance
      for(i in 1:nrow(train_country_summary)) {
        diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_train[i, ]), "-")
        train_dist_matrix[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
      }
    }
    rownames(train_dist_matrix) <- train_country_summary$company_location
    colnames(train_dist_matrix) <- train_country_summary$company_location
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. EXTRACT FOLD-ISOLATED MEMS
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    agg_predictors <- c("years_experience", "remote_ratio", "benefits_score", "company_size_num", "education_num")
    min_dist <- min(train_dist_matrix[train_dist_matrix > 0])
    max_dist <- max(train_dist_matrix)
    adjusted_thresholds <- seq(from = min_dist, to = max_dist / 2, length.out = 5)
    
    raw_mems <- safe_extract_mems(train_country_summary, "salary_usd", agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds)
    spatial_features_train_raw <- data.frame(company_location = train_country_summary$company_location, raw_mems)
    colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1], "_raw")
    spatial_vars_raw <- colnames(spatial_features_train_raw)[-1]
    
    log_mems <- safe_extract_mems(train_country_summary, "log_salary_usd", agg_predictors, train_dist_matrix, adjusted_thresholds)
    spatial_features_train_log <- data.frame(company_location = train_country_summary$company_location, log_mems)
    colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1], "_log")
    spatial_vars_log <- colnames(spatial_features_train_log)[-1]
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. PROJECT MEMS ONTO TEST DATA (Zero Data Leakage)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    unique_test_countries <- unique(test_data$company_location)
    spatial_features_test_raw <- data.frame(company_location = unique_test_countries)
    spatial_features_test_log <- data.frame(company_location = unique_test_countries)
    
    for (sv in spatial_vars_raw) spatial_features_test_raw[[sv]] <- NA
    for (sv in spatial_vars_log) spatial_features_test_log[[sv]] <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:length(unique_test_countries)) {
      test_country <- unique_test_countries[i]
      test_country_macro <- as.matrix(econ_lookup[econ_lookup$company_location == test_country, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
      
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_train, 2, as.numeric(test_country_macro), "-")
      
      if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
        dist_to_train <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_train) * diff_matrix))
      } else {
        dist_to_train <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
      }
      
      inv_weights <- 1 / (dist_to_train + 1e-6)
      normalized_weights <- inv_weights / sum(inv_weights)
      
      for (sv in spatial_vars_raw) {
        spatial_features_test_raw[i, sv] <- sum(spatial_features_train_raw[[sv]] * normalized_weights)
      }
      for (sv in spatial_vars_log) {
        spatial_features_test_log[i, sv] <- sum(spatial_features_train_log[[sv]] * normalized_weights)
      }
    }
    
    train_data <- train_data %>% left_join(spatial_features_train_raw, by = "company_location") %>% left_join(spatial_features_train_log, by = "company_location")
    test_data <- test_data %>% left_join(spatial_features_test_raw, by = "company_location") %>% left_join(spatial_features_test_log, by = "company_location")
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. XGBOOST MATRIX SETUP & TRAINING
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    features_spatial_raw <- c(base_features, current_macro_vars, spatial_vars_raw)
    features_spatial_log <- c(base_features, current_macro_vars, spatial_vars_log)
    
    X_train_raw <- as.matrix(train_data[, features_spatial_raw])
    X_test_raw  <- as.matrix(test_data[, features_spatial_raw])
    y_train_raw <- train_data$salary_usd
    
    X_train_log <- as.matrix(train_data[, features_spatial_log])
    X_test_log  <- as.matrix(test_data[, features_spatial_log])
    y_train_log <- train_data$log_salary_usd
    
    train_locations <- train_data$company_location
    
    best_params_raw <- tune_xgb(X_train_raw, y_train_raw, train_locations)
    best_params_log <- tune_xgb(X_train_log, y_train_log, train_locations)
    
    dtrain_raw <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train_raw, label = y_train_raw)
    dtest_raw  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test_raw)
    model_xgb_spatial_raw_fold <- xgb.train(params = best_params_raw[names(best_params_raw) != "nrounds"], data = dtrain_raw, nrounds = best_params_raw$nrounds)
    current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_raw[test_idx] <- predict(model_xgb_spatial_raw_fold, dtest_raw)
    
    dtrain_log <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train_log, label = y_train_log)
    dtest_log  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test_log)
    model_xgb_spatial_log_fold <- xgb.train(params = best_params_log[names(best_params_log) != "nrounds"], data = dtrain_log, nrounds = best_params_log$nrounds)
    current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_log[test_idx] <- exp(predict(model_xgb_spatial_log_fold, dtest_log))
  }
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 5. EVALUATION: INDIVIDUAL ROW LEVEL (15,000 Records - Weighted by Dataset Composition)
  # ==============================================================================
  cat("Evaluating Metrics and Residual Autocorrelation on full dataset...\n")
  
  # 1. Calculate overall RMSE and R-Squared at the individual row level
  resids_raw <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_raw
  resids_log <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_xgb_spatial_log
  
  r2_raw <- 1 - (sum(resids_raw^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  r2_log <- 1 - (sum(resids_log^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(mean(resids_raw^2))
  rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(resids_log^2))
  
  # 2. Build Full Row-Level Distance Matrix
  macro_mat_full <- as.matrix(current_job_data[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
  full_mahalanobis_dist <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(current_job_data), ncol = nrow(current_job_data))
  
  if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
    cov_matrix_full <- cov(macro_mat_full)
    if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_full <- matrix(cov_matrix_full, 1, 1)
    diag(cov_matrix_full) <- diag(cov_matrix_full) + 1e-6 
    inv_cov_matrix_full <- solve(cov_matrix_full)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_full) * diff_matrix))
    }
  } else {
    # Default to Euclidean Distance
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. THE ROW-LEVEL FIX: Use 1 / (Distance + 1)
  inv_dist_weights_full <- 1 / (full_mahalanobis_dist + 1)
  diag(inv_dist_weights_full) <- 0 # A row cannot be its own neighbor
  
  # 4. Calculate Moran's I on all ~15,000 residuals
  moran_raw <- Moran.I(resids_raw, inv_dist_weights_full)
  moran_log <- Moran.I(resids_log, inv_dist_weights_full)
  
  ablation_results_sxgb <- rbind(
    ablation_results_sxgb,
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Spatial XGBoost (Raw)", RMSE = rmse_raw, R_Squared = r2_raw, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_raw$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_raw$p.value),
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Spatial XGBoost (Log)", RMSE = rmse_log, R_Squared = r2_log, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_log$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_log$p.value)
  )
}

print(ablation_results_sxgb)
```

```{r normal XGBoost}
# ==============================================================================
# ABLATION STUDY: NORMAL XGBOOST (RAW VS LOG) - NESTED CV ENHANCED
# (Updated with Distance Toggle, Spatial Block CV & Row-Level Moran's I Evaluation)
# ==============================================================================
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)   # Using ape for consistent Moran's I evaluation
library(stats) # Required for cov()

# --- NEW: DISTANCE TOGGLE ---
distance_method <- "mahalanobis" # Change to "mahalanobis" or "euclidean" to toggle distance calculation

# 0. DEFINE ABLATION COMBINATIONS & STORAGE
macro_combinations <- list(
  comb_1 = c("gdp_pc"),
  comb_2 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living"),
  comb_3 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index"),
  comb_4 = c("gdp_pc", "cost_of_living", "tech_index", "human_capital_index")
)

ablation_results_nxgb <- data.frame(
  Combination = character(), Model = character(), 
  RMSE = numeric(), R_Squared = numeric(), 
  Morans_I_Obs = numeric(), Morans_I_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Base predictors (Including Economic Arbitrage from Feedback #1)
industry_cols <- colnames(industry_dummies)
base_features <- c("years_experience", "remote_ratio", "company_size_num", 
                   "education_num", "benefits_score", 
                   "arbitrage_gdp_ratio", "arbitrage_col_ratio", industry_cols)

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE TUNING FUNCTION (STRATIFIED INNER 3-FOLD)
# ==============================================================================
tune_xgb <- function(X, y, train_locations) {
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y)
  best_rmse <- Inf
  best_params <- NULL
  best_nrounds <- 100 
  
  # CREATE INNER STRATIFIED 3-FOLDS
  # Group by country to ensure proportional representation in the inner validation
  set.seed(123) 
  inner_fold_assign <- data.frame(location = train_locations, row_id = 1:nrow(X)) %>%
    group_by(location) %>%
    mutate(inner_fold = sample(rep(1:3, length.out = n()))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # xgb.cv expects a list where each element contains the TEST row indices for that fold
  custom_cv_folds <- list(
    Fold1 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 1),
    Fold2 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 2),
    Fold3 = which(inner_fold_assign$inner_fold == 3)
  )
  
  param_grid <- expand.grid(
    max_depth = c(3, 5, 7),
    eta = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
    min_child_weight = c(1, 3, 5)
  )
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
    params <- list(
      objective = "reg:squarederror", max_depth = param_grid$max_depth[i],
      eta = param_grid$eta[i], min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
      subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8, seed = 123
    )
    
    cv_res <- xgb.cv(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 1000, folds = custom_cv_folds,
                     early_stopping_rounds = 20, metrics = "rmse", verbose = 0)
    
    current_rmse <- min(cv_res$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
    opt_nrounds <- if(!is.null(cv_res$best_iteration) && length(cv_res$best_iteration) > 0 && cv_res$best_iteration > 0) {
      cv_res$best_iteration
    } else {
      which.min(cv_res$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
    }
    
    if(current_rmse < best_rmse) {
      best_rmse <- current_rmse
      best_params <- params
      best_nrounds <- opt_nrounds
    }
  }
  best_params$nrounds <- as.integer(best_nrounds)
  return(best_params)
}

# ==============================================================================
# START NORMAL XGBOOST ABLATION LOOP
# ==============================================================================
for (comb_name in names(macro_combinations)) {
  current_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[[comb_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n=== RUNNING NORMAL XGBOOST ABLATION: %s (%d Variables) ===\n", comb_name, length(current_macro_vars)))
  
  # Ensure clean target columns per iteration
  current_job_data <- as.data.frame(job_data_econ)
  current_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(current_job_data$salary_usd)
  current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_raw <- NA
  current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_log <- NA
  
  # --- A. DYNAMIC FEATURE MATRIX CONSTRUCTION ---
  current_features <- c(base_features, current_macro_vars)
  X_data <- as.matrix(current_job_data[, current_features])
  y_raw <- current_job_data$salary_usd
  y_log <- current_job_data$log_salary_usd
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # B. TRAIN MODELS VIA NESTED 5-FOLD SPATIAL BLOCK CV (LOCO)
  # ==============================================================================
  cat("Running Nested 5-Fold CV (LOCO)...\n")
  for(f in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- which(current_job_data$fold != f)
    test_idx  <- which(current_job_data$fold == f)
    
    cat("  -> Tuning & Training Fold", f, "...\n")
    
    train_locations <- current_job_data$company_location[train_idx]
    
    # 1. TUNE EXCLUSIVELY ON THE TRAINING FOLD
    best_params_xgb_raw <- tune_xgb(X_data[train_idx, ], y_raw[train_idx], train_locations)
    best_params_xgb_log <- tune_xgb(X_data[train_idx, ], y_log[train_idx], train_locations)
    
    train_params_raw <- best_params_xgb_raw[names(best_params_xgb_raw) != "nrounds"]
    train_params_log <- best_params_xgb_log[names(best_params_xgb_log) != "nrounds"]
    
    # 2. TRAIN RAW MODEL
    dtrain_raw <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_data[train_idx, ], label = y_raw[train_idx])
    dtest_raw  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_data[test_idx, ])
    
    model_xgb_raw_fold <- xgb.train(params = train_params_raw, data = dtrain_raw, nrounds = best_params_xgb_raw$nrounds)
    current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_raw[test_idx] <- predict(model_xgb_raw_fold, dtest_raw)
    
    # 3. TRAIN LOG MODEL
    dtrain_log <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_data[train_idx, ], label = y_log[train_idx])
    dtest_log  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_data[test_idx, ])
    
    model_xgb_log_fold <- xgb.train(params = train_params_log, data = dtrain_log, nrounds = best_params_xgb_log$nrounds)
    current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_log[test_idx] <- exp(predict(model_xgb_log_fold, dtest_log))
  }
  
  # --- C. EVALUATION: INDIVIDUAL ROW LEVEL (15,000 Records - Weighted by Dataset Composition) ---
  cat("Evaluating Metrics and Residual Autocorrelation on full dataset...\n")
  
  # 1. Calculate overall RMSE and R-Squared at the individual row level
  resids_raw <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_raw
  resids_log <- current_job_data$salary_usd - current_job_data$pred_xgb_normal_log
  
  r2_raw <- 1 - (sum(resids_raw^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  r2_log <- 1 - (sum(resids_log^2) / sum((current_job_data$salary_usd - mean(current_job_data$salary_usd))^2))
  
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(mean(resids_raw^2))
  rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(resids_log^2))
  
  # 2. Build Full Row-Level Distance Matrix based on selected method
  macro_mat_full <- as.matrix(current_job_data[, current_macro_vars, drop = FALSE])
  full_mahalanobis_dist <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(current_job_data), ncol = nrow(current_job_data))
  
  if(distance_method == "mahalanobis") {
    cov_matrix_full <- cov(macro_mat_full)
    if (length(current_macro_vars) == 1) cov_matrix_full <- matrix(cov_matrix_full, 1, 1)
    diag(cov_matrix_full) <- diag(cov_matrix_full) + 1e-6 
    inv_cov_matrix_full <- solve(cov_matrix_full)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums((diff_matrix %*% inv_cov_matrix_full) * diff_matrix))
    }
  } else {
    # Default to Euclidean Distance
    for(i in 1:nrow(current_job_data)) {
      diff_matrix <- sweep(macro_mat_full, 2, as.numeric(macro_mat_full[i, ]), "-")
      full_mahalanobis_dist[i, ] <- sqrt(rowSums(diff_matrix^2))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. THE ROW-LEVEL FIX: Use 1 / (Distance + 1)
  inv_dist_weights_full <- 1 / (full_mahalanobis_dist + 1)
  diag(inv_dist_weights_full) <- 0 # A row cannot be its own neighbor
  
  # 4. Calculate Moran's I on all ~15,000 residuals
  moran_raw <- Moran.I(resids_raw, inv_dist_weights_full)
  moran_log <- Moran.I(resids_log, inv_dist_weights_full)
  
  # Append to results
  ablation_results_nxgb <- rbind(
    ablation_results_nxgb,
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Normal XGBoost (Raw)", RMSE = rmse_raw, R_Squared = r2_raw, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_raw$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_raw$p.value),
    data.frame(Combination = comb_name, Model = "Normal XGBoost (Log)", RMSE = rmse_log, R_Squared = r2_log, 
               Morans_I_Obs = moran_log$observed, Morans_I_p = moran_log$p.value)
  )
}

print(ablation_results_nxgb)
```

```{r Model Evaluation (Latest)}
if(!exists("model_spatial_full_raw")) {
  model_spatial_full_raw <- ranger(
    dependent.variable.name = "salary_usd", 
    data = data_spatial_raw[, c("salary_usd", all_predictors_raw)],
    num.trees = 500, mtry = best_params_raw$mtry, 
    min.node.size = best_params_raw$min.node.size, importance = "permutation", seed = 123
  )
}
if(!exists("model_spatial_full_log")) {
  model_spatial_full_log <- ranger(
    dependent.variable.name = "log_salary_usd", 
    data = data_spatial_log[, c("log_salary_usd", all_predictors_log)],
    num.trees = 500, mtry = best_params_log$mtry, 
    min.node.size = best_params_log$min.node.size, importance = "permutation", seed = 123
  )
}

# Helper function to safely extract features
get_features <- function(model_name) {
  tryCatch({
    if (grepl("Normal RF.*Raw", model_name)) return(paste(names(sort(ranger::importance(model_normal_raw), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Normal RF.*Log", model_name)) return(paste(names(sort(ranger::importance(model_normal_log), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Spatial RF.*Raw", model_name)) return(paste(names(sort(ranger::importance(model_spatial_full_raw), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Spatial RF.*Log", model_name)) return(paste(names(sort(ranger::importance(model_spatial_full_log), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Normal XGBoost.*Raw", model_name)) return(paste(head(importance_raw$Feature, 3), collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Normal XGBoost.*Log", model_name)) return(paste(head(importance_log$Feature, 3), collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Spatial XGBoost.*Raw", model_name)) return(paste(head(importance_spatial_raw$Feature, 3), collapse = ", "))
    if (grepl("Spatial XGBoost.*Log", model_name)) return(paste(head(importance_spatial_log$Feature, 3), collapse = ", "))
    return("N/A")
  }, error = function(e) return("Error"))
}

# Apply feature extraction to the final table
final_summary$Top_3_Features <- sapply(final_summary$Model, get_features)

# Format decimals for clean printing
final_summary <- final_summary %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE = sprintf("%.2f", RMSE),
    R_Squared = sprintf("%.4f", R_Squared),
    Morans_I_Obs = sprintf("%.4f", Morans_I_Obs),
    Morans_I_p = sprintf("%.4e", Morans_I_p)
  )

# 4. DISPLAY RESULTS
cat("\n========================================================================================================\n")
cat("                                 OVERALL FINAL MODEL COMPARISON SUMMARY\n")
cat("========================================================================================================\n")
print(as.data.frame(final_summary))
```
