```{r SHAP Analysis}
# ==============================================================================
# 16. SHAP ANALYSIS FOR ALL 8 FINAL GLOBAL MODELS (PHASE 2)
# ==============================================================================
# Install required packages if missing: install.packages(c("shapviz", "kernelshap", "ggplot2", "dplyr"))
library(xgboost)
library(ranger)
library(shapviz)
library(kernelshap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
load("Phase2_SHAP_Data.RData")

# ==============================================================================
# 0. PREPARE 100% DATA MATRICES FOR THE BEST COMBINATION (e.g., comb_4)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nPreparing final feature matrices for SHAP Analysis (Comb_4)...\n")
best_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[["comb_4"]]

# Ensure we are using the master dataset AND merging the spatial features 
# generated during the final comb_4 loop iteration.
final_job_data <- job_data_econ %>%
  left_join(spatial_features_raw, by = "company_location") %>%
  left_join(spatial_features_log, by = "company_location")

# Ensure the log dependent variable exists
final_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(final_job_data$salary_usd)

# Define the exact features used in the final models
features_normal <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars)
features_spatial_raw <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars, spatial_vars_raw)
features_spatial_log <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars, spatial_vars_log)

# Construct the matrices needed for SHAP evaluation
X_normal <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_normal])
X_spatial_raw <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_spatial_raw])
X_spatial_log <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_spatial_log])


# ==============================================================================
# 1. SHAP FOR XGBOOST MODELS (Native & Fast TreeSHAP)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nExtracting SHAP values for XGBoost Models (100% of data)...\n")

# Normal XGBoost Models (Assumes model_xgb_full_raw and log were trained in Phase 2)
shp_xgb_normal_raw <- shapviz(model_xgb_full_raw, X_pred = X_normal)
shp_xgb_normal_log <- shapviz(model_xgb_full_log, X_pred = X_normal)

# Spatial XGBoost Models (Assumes model_xgb_spatial_full_raw and log were trained in Phase 2)
shp_xgb_spatial_raw <- shapviz(model_xgb_spatial_full_raw, X_pred = X_spatial_raw)
shp_xgb_spatial_log <- shapviz(model_xgb_spatial_full_log, X_pred = X_spatial_log)


# ==============================================================================
# 2. SHAP FOR RANDOM FOREST MODELS (via Model-Agnostic KernelSHAP)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nExtracting SHAP values for Random Forest Models (Using ~500-row stratified sample)...\n")

# --- STRATIFIED SAMPLING BY COUNTRY ---
set.seed(123)

# 1. Calculate how many rows to sample per country to get ~500 total proportionally
country_counts <- table(final_job_data$company_location)
target_total <- 500

# Calculate sizes and FORCE the country names back onto the vector
sample_sizes <- pmax(1, round(country_counts * target_total / nrow(final_job_data)))
names(sample_sizes) <- names(country_counts)

# 2. Extract indices proportionally, ensuring every country gets at least 1 representative
sample_idx <- unlist(lapply(names(country_counts), function(country) {
  indices <- which(final_job_data$company_location == country)
  size <- min(length(indices), sample_sizes[country])
  
  # R's sample() has a quirk where if length(indices)==1, it samples from 1:indices.
  # To be 100% safe for countries with exactly 1 row:
  if(length(indices) == 1) return(indices)
  
  sample(indices, size)
}))

# 3. Shuffle the final indices
sample_idx <- sample(sample_idx)

cat(sprintf("Stratified sample created: %d rows representing all %d countries.\n", 
            length(sample_idx), length(unique(final_job_data$company_location[sample_idx]))))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define a prediction wrapper for ranger models so they accept matrix inputs correctly
pred_rf <- function(model, X) {
  predict(model, data = as.data.frame(X))$predictions
}

# --- Normal Random Forest ---
ks_rf_normal_raw <- kernelshap(model_rf_full_raw, X = X_normal[sample_idx, ], 
                               bg_X = X_normal[sample_idx, ], pred_fun = pred_rf)
shp_rf_normal_raw <- shapviz(ks_rf_normal_raw)

ks_rf_normal_log <- kernelshap(model_rf_full_log, X = X_normal[sample_idx, ], 
                               bg_X = X_normal[sample_idx, ], pred_fun = pred_rf)
shp_rf_normal_log <- shapviz(ks_rf_normal_log)

# --- Spatial Random Forest ---
ks_rf_spatial_raw <- kernelshap(model_spatial_full_raw, X = X_spatial_raw[sample_idx, ], 
                                bg_X = X_spatial_raw[sample_idx, ], pred_fun = pred_rf)
shp_rf_spatial_raw <- shapviz(ks_rf_spatial_raw)

ks_rf_spatial_log <- kernelshap(model_spatial_full_log, X = X_spatial_log[sample_idx, ], 
                                bg_X = X_spatial_log[sample_idx, ], pred_fun = pred_rf)
shp_rf_spatial_log <- shapviz(ks_rf_spatial_log)


# ==============================================================================
# 3. VISUALIZING THE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nGenerating SHAP Summary Plots for the Final Global Models...\n")

# --- XGBoost Models ---
p_xgb_normal_raw <- sv_importance(shp_xgb_normal_raw, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Normal XGBoost (Raw, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_xgb_normal_log <- sv_importance(shp_xgb_normal_log, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Normal XGBoost (Log, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_xgb_spatial_raw <- sv_importance(shp_xgb_spatial_raw, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Spatial XGBoost (Raw, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_xgb_spatial_log <- sv_importance(shp_xgb_spatial_log, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Spatial XGBoost (Log, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

# --- Random Forest Models ---
p_rf_normal_raw <- sv_importance(shp_rf_normal_raw, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Normal Random Forest (Raw, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_rf_normal_log <- sv_importance(shp_rf_normal_log, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Normal Random Forest (Log, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_rf_spatial_raw <- sv_importance(shp_rf_spatial_raw, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Spatial Random Forest (Raw, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

p_rf_spatial_log <- sv_importance(shp_rf_spatial_log, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 10) + 
  ggtitle("SHAP Summary: Spatial Random Forest (Log, Comb 4)") + theme_minimal()

# Display them one by one:
print(p_xgb_normal_raw)
print(p_xgb_normal_log)
print(p_xgb_spatial_raw)
print(p_xgb_spatial_log)
print(p_rf_normal_raw)
```

```{r Save SHAP}
library(xgboost)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)

cat("\n--- STARTING PHASE 2: GLOBAL MODEL TRAINING (100% DATA) ---\n")

# 1. RECONSTRUCT THE MASTER DATASET FOR COMBINATION 4
best_macro_vars <- macro_combinations[["comb_4"]]

final_job_data <- job_data_econ %>%
  left_join(spatial_features_raw, by = "company_location") %>%
  left_join(spatial_features_log, by = "company_location")

final_job_data$log_salary_usd <- log(final_job_data$salary_usd)

# 2. DEFINE 100% FEATURE MATRICES
features_normal <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars)
features_spatial_raw <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars, spatial_vars_raw)
features_spatial_log <- c(base_features, best_macro_vars, spatial_vars_log)

X_normal <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_normal])
X_spatial_raw <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_spatial_raw])
X_spatial_log <- as.matrix(final_job_data[, features_spatial_log])

y_raw <- final_job_data$salary_usd
y_log <- final_job_data$log_salary_usd
train_locations <- final_job_data$company_location

# 3. TRAIN GLOBAL RANDOM FOREST MODELS
cat("Training Global Random Forest Models...\n")
model_rf_full_raw <- ranger(x = X_normal, y = y_raw, num.trees = 500, importance = "permutation", seed = 123)
model_rf_full_log <- ranger(x = X_normal, y = y_log, num.trees = 500, importance = "permutation", seed = 123)

model_spatial_full_raw <- ranger(x = X_spatial_raw, y = y_raw, num.trees = 500, importance = "permutation", seed = 123)
model_spatial_full_log <- ranger(x = X_spatial_log, y = y_log, num.trees = 500, importance = "permutation", seed = 123)

# 4. TRAIN GLOBAL XGBOOST MODELS (Re-using your tune_xgb function)
cat("Tuning & Training Global XGBoost Models...\n")

best_params_n_raw <- tune_xgb(X_normal, y_raw, train_locations)
model_xgb_full_raw <- xgb.train(params = best_params_n_raw[names(best_params_n_raw) != "nrounds"], 
                                data = xgb.DMatrix(X_normal, label = y_raw), nrounds = best_params_n_raw$nrounds)

best_params_n_log <- tune_xgb(X_normal, y_log, train_locations)
model_xgb_full_log <- xgb.train(params = best_params_n_log[names(best_params_n_log) != "nrounds"], 
                                data = xgb.DMatrix(X_normal, label = y_log), nrounds = best_params_n_log$nrounds)

best_params_s_raw <- tune_xgb(X_spatial_raw, y_raw, train_locations)
model_xgb_spatial_full_raw <- xgb.train(params = best_params_s_raw[names(best_params_s_raw) != "nrounds"], 
                                        data = xgb.DMatrix(X_spatial_raw, label = y_raw), nrounds = best_params_s_raw$nrounds)

best_params_s_log <- tune_xgb(X_spatial_log, y_log, train_locations)
model_xgb_spatial_full_log <- xgb.train(params = best_params_s_log[names(best_params_s_log) != "nrounds"], 
                                        data = xgb.DMatrix(X_spatial_log, label = y_log), nrounds = best_params_s_log$nrounds)

# 5. SAVE EXACTLY WHAT IS NEEDED FOR SHAP (AND NOTHING ELSE)
cat("Packaging final models for SHAP extraction...\n")
save(
  final_job_data,
  base_features, best_macro_vars, spatial_vars_raw, spatial_vars_log,
  model_xgb_full_raw, model_xgb_full_log,
  model_xgb_spatial_full_raw, model_xgb_spatial_full_log,
  model_rf_full_raw, model_rf_full_log,
  model_spatial_full_raw, model_spatial_full_log,
  file = "Phase2_SHAP_Data.RData"
)

cat("\n--- SUCCESS: Phase 2 Complete. File 'Phase2_SHAP_Data.RData' is ready. ---\n")
```
